plugins.name: lexponent
plugins.description:
Lexponent connects Claude to federal and state court rules, including local rules and orders, as well as procedural statutes. Build filing checklists, review a draft against the court's rules before it's filed, map the procedural timeline that follows a trigger event, generate court-specific practice guides, and get answers to procedural questions. Every statement links to the rule it rests on, so you can verify it in one click.

Built for litigators, paralegals, legal assistants, and docketing staff. Covers every federal court and a growing list of states. Requires a Lexponent account.
